propositions: The documented curl command using `git rev-parse --git-path hooks/commit-msg` from a linked worktree resolves to the shared main checkout's hooks directory, clobbering the pre-commit wrapper across all worktrees.

The overwrite silently breaks Change-Id stamping and pre-commit's 50/72 message gate, with failures only surfacing at `git push gerrit` potentially in a different worktree than the one that ran the install.
AGENTS.md and CONTRIBUTING.md document an unsafe bare curl installation path that bypasses the pre-commit migration chain and must be replaced with a single documented idempotent path.

The fix consolidates hook installation into `make hooks` via a new cwd-independent, non-destructive, idempotent `scripts/install-gerrit-hook.sh` that installs the Gerrit stamper to `commit-msg.legacy` when a pre-commit wrapper owns the `commit-msg` slot.

The new installer refuses to overwrite non-pre-commit, non-stamper hooks, validates that fetched payloads contain Change-Id logic, and supports offline testing via `REBAR_GERRIT_HOOK_SOURCE` environment variable.
